description: Fix cursor-based pagination when EPSS sort is active. The Cursor struct stores a *time.Time which cannot represent a float EPSS score. The fix disables cursor emission for EPSS sort (client uses offset-based pagination) and adds defensive handling in the cursor decoding path to preserve the original sort order if an EPSS cursor is somehow encountered.
steps: In internal/server/server.go, add a check for EPSS sort prefix before cursor generation: if sortKey starts with 'epss', skip cursor generation so the client falls back to offset-based pagination
In internal/store/postgres.go Search method, add a case for cursor.SortKey == 'epss' that preserves the original sortOrder and skips keyset conditions
In internal/store/postgres.go searchLight method, add the same defensive handling for cursor.SortKey == 'epss'
acceptance_criteria: When EPSS sort is active, no next_cursor is returned in the API response
If a cursor with SortKey 'epss' is decoded, the original sort order is preserved and no keyset condition is applied
findings: Fix applied cleanly. Build passes and all tests pass. The approach avoids data corruption by not emitting cursors for EPSS sort, letting the client use offset-based pagination instead.
